exercise.name: Band Squat to Overhead Press

reference.title: Band Squat to Overhead Press
reference.listing: Video (movement reference only; the page could not be fetched from the authoring environment, so the data sheet was not read)
reference.note: Reference used only to identify the movement. No GymVisual media is stored here; this rig, model and animation are original.

exercise.mechanics: Compound (hip, knee, ankle, shoulder and elbow)

breathing.pattern: Breathe in and brace at the top, squat down and stand up; breathe out as you press; breathe in again as the hands come back to the shoulders.
breathing.cadence: About 1.4 s down, 1 s up and press, about 1 s back to the shoulders

prescription.tempo: 2 s down, up, then press; 1 s back to the shoulders
prescription.progression: More reps, then a stronger band or the feet wider on the band. Band tension is user-chosen: pick one that leaves about 2-3 reps in reserve at the end of each set.

cues.text: Stand on the middle of the band, feet about shoulder width, toes slightly out; an end in each hand at the front of the shoulders, palms in, elbows forward.
Breathe in, brace and squat until the hip crease is just below the knees; heels down, knees out.
Chest up, elbows up, hands staying at the shoulders.
Drive the floor away and stand all the way up.
Breathe out and press both hands straight up past the face to straight arms, biceps by the ears, ribs down.
Bring the hands back to the shoulders under control before the next squat.

mistakes.mistake: Letting the knees cave in toward the band
mistakes.fix: Push the knees out over the toes; the strands run outside the knees.

mistakes.mistake: Arching the low back at lockout
mistakes.fix: Brace the ribs down; finish with the hands over the middle of the feet.
Finish the squat first, then press.

mistakes.mistake: Feet sliding so the band slips out
mistakes.fix: Stand on the middle of the band with the whole foot pressed down.

kinematics.norm: About shoulder width, toes slightly out (CrossFit 2019)
Hip crease just below the top of the knees at the bottom (CrossFit 2019)
Fairly upright under the front load (Gullett 2009); neutral spine (CrossFit 2019)

kinematics.setup: ≈15° with the hands at the shoulders (upper arm from vertical)
kinematics.norm: Arms fully extended overhead, the load stacked over the hips and ankles (CrossFit 2019)

kinematics.setup: Hands stay at the shoulders through the squat
kinematics.peak: Press starts once standing tall; lockout 0.7 s later
kinematics.norm: In this combination the press starts once standing tall (clinical opinion); in the thruster the press starts as the hips and knees finish extending (CrossFit 2019)

kinematics.setup: Under the balls of the feet; strand 94.1 cm at the bottom of the squat
kinematics.peak: Strand 195 cm at lockout (most stretch, most tension)
kinematics.norm: Standing on the band, its tension rises as the hands move away from the feet: lightest at the bottom of the squat, heaviest at lockout (at matched effort elastic tubing and dumbbells gave similar muscle activity in a shoulder raise; Andersen 2010)

kinematics.peak: 1.45 s down, 0.15 s bottom, 0.8 s up, 0.7 s press, 0.4 s lockout, 1 s back to the shoulders

sources.title: GymVisual #25245, Band Squat to Overhead Press, video (movement reference)
CrossFit 2019, The Thruster (CrossFit Essentials, coaching article, 12 April 2019)
Gullett, Tillman, Gutierrez & Chow 2009, a biomechanical comparison of back and front squats in healthy trained individuals (J Strength Cond Res 23(1):284-292; PubMed 19002072)
Straub and Powers 2024, a biomechanical review of the squat exercise: implications for clinical practice (Int J Sports Phys Ther)

Andersen, Andersen, Mortensen, Poulsen, Bjornlund and Zebis 2010, muscle activation and perceived loading during rehabilitation exercises: comparison of dumbbells and elastic resistance (Phys Ther 90(4):538-549)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, numbness or giving-way occurs.
Check the band for nicks or tears and stand firmly on its middle; a band that slips out from under the feet can snap up toward the face.
Band tension is user-chosen: pick one you can press to straight arms without arching.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
modify: Shoulder discomfort overhead: press to the forehead only.
Knee pain: squat to a box or a shallower depth.
regressions: Band front squat and a separate band press.
progressions: Stronger band or feet wider on the band.

muscleNotes.quads_r: Drive the squat out of the bottom (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.quads_l: Drive the squat out of the bottom (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Hip extensor out of the bottom of the front squat (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Hip extensor out of the bottom of the front squat (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_r: Presses the hands overhead once standing; the band is tightest at lockout (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.ant_deltoid_l: Presses the hands overhead once standing; the band is tightest at lockout (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_r: Lifts the elbows up and out as the hands pass the head (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.lat_deltoid_l: Lifts the elbows up and out as the hands pass the head (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.triceps_r: Straighten the elbows to lock the hands out overhead.
muscleNotes.triceps_l: Straighten the elbows to lock the hands out overhead.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Rotate and lift the shoulder blades so the arms can finish overhead; "shoulders drive up toward the bar" (CrossFit 2019).
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Rotate and lift the shoulder blades so the arms can finish overhead; "shoulders drive up toward the bar" (CrossFit 2019).
muscleNotes.serratus_r: Rotates the shoulder blades upward at lockout (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.serratus_l: Rotates the shoulder blades upward at lockout (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.adductors_r: Assist hip extension out of the deep squat (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.adductors_l: Assist hip extension out of the deep squat (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.hamstrings_r: Assist hip extension and steady the knee (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.hamstrings_l: Assist hip extension and steady the knee (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.calves_r: Finish the leg drive and steady the shins (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.calves_l: Finish the leg drive and steady the shins (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.core: Keeps the trunk neutral in the squat and stops the low back arching at lockout (CrossFit 2019).
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Hold the chest up in the squat (clinical opinion).
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Hold the chest up in the squat (clinical opinion).
